title: Use calc to deduct the white space on both sides of the picture card
goal: Combine percentages with fixed lengths in CSS calculations.
summary: The navigation map needs to leave 12px on both sides when it is stuck on a small screen, and the maximum width is 360px when the screen is wide.
tasks: Use calc to make the width of .route the available width minus 24px.
remains centered left and right, with a maximum width of 360px.

example.note: calc can mix percentages and lengths. Spaces are required on both sides of the plus and minus signs.

hint: The total white space on both sides is 24px. Use max-width to cap, and auto-margins to center.
